description: Implementation of the BankingService interface handling customer, account, transaction operations, and transfers for a banking application.

classes.name: BankingServiceImpl
classes.description: Service class implementing banking operations such as customer management, account creation, fund transfers, and transaction retrieval, with dependency injections for repositories and helper services.

methods.name: findAll
methods.description: Retrieves all customers and converts them into domain objects.

methods.name: addCustomer
methods.description: Creates a new customer record in the database.

methods.name: findByCustomerNumber
methods.description: Finds a customer by their customer number.

methods.name: updateCustomer
methods.description: Updates existing customer details based on provided customer information.

methods.name: deleteCustomer
methods.description: Deletes a customer record by customer number.

methods.name: findByAccountNumber
methods.description: Retrieves account details by account number.

methods.name: addNewAccount
methods.description: Creates a new bank account linked to a customer.

methods.name: transferDetails
methods.description: Transfers funds from one account to another for a specified customer, ensuring sufficient balance, and creating appropriate transaction records.

methods.name: findTransactionsByAccountNumber
methods.description: Retrieves all transactions associated with a specific account number.
